conv_channels: Channel width of the conv layer(s)
num_params_approx: Approximate parameter count of the model
epochs: Training epochs (passes over the 50k training set)
custom_kernels: Whether custom Triton/CUDA kernels are used
ema: Use exponential moving average of weights
normalization_in_model: Whether input normalization is inside the model
data_on_gpu: Training data moved to GPU in prepare
num_seeds_eval: Number of seeds used per experiment measurement
whitening_init: Frozen patch-whitening 2x2 conv first layer initialized from training data covariance
whitening_images: Number of training images used to estimate the patch-whitening covariance for the first-layer init
low_res_input_resolution: Pixel resolution that augmented training batches are downsampled to during the early low-resolution phase
low_res_step_fraction: Fraction of training steps run at the low resolution before switching to full resolution
resize_mode: Interpolation method used to downsample training batches
data_selection: Online example selection method for main-net training steps
proxy_conv_channels: Channel widths of the small proxy net used to score examples
superbatch_size: Number of images scored by the proxy per selection round
selection_fraction: Fraction of each superbatch (highest loss) kept for main-net training
translate_pixels: Maximum random translation amplitude in pixels (reflect padding)
mid_res_input_resolution: Pixel resolution of the intermediate phase in a three-phase resolution curriculum
num_resolution_phases: Number of distinct training resolution phases
optimizer_foreach_in_cuda_graph: Optimizer update implemented with compiled foreach ops inside the CUDA-graph-captured train step
lr_table_on_gpu: Per-step LR and Lookahead alpha read from a precomputed GPU tensor table indexed by a GPU step counter
build_data_path_warmup: Build warms the data-loading path (pinned copy, H2D, normalize) on synthetic full-size tensors
lr_final_fraction: LR at the end of decay as a fraction of peak LR
muon_learning_rate: Learning rate for Muon-optimized conv filter weights
muon_momentum: Momentum for the Muon optimizer on conv filters
muon_newton_schulz_dtype: Dtype used for Newton-Schulz orthogonalization in Muon
optimizer_fused_sgd: Whether torch.optim.SGD uses the fused=True CUDA implementation (single fused kernel for parameter updates)
build_full_path_warmup: Build runs the whole prepare/train path (H2D copy, whitening eigh, augmentation, fused SGD, Lookahead) on synthetic full-size data so the first trial pays no lazy-init cost
muon_newton_schulz_steps: Number of Newton-Schulz iterations used by Muon to orthogonalize the conv filter updates
muon_batched_ns_by_shape: Same-shape conv filters are stacked and orthogonalized with one batched Newton-Schulz bmm
muon_step_in_cuda_graph: Whole Muon update is compiled together with the SGD/Lookahead update inside the CUDA-graph train step
whiten_bias_epochs: Number of epochs the whitening-conv bias is trained before being frozen
phase_cuda_graph: Each resolution phase of training is captured as a single CUDA graph covering all its steps
stage_phase_batches_upfront: Augmented, gathered batches for a whole phase are staged into persistent per-step buffers at start of train
lookahead: Whether Lookahead-style slow-weight interpolation (every 5 steps, with final copy of slow weights into the model) is applied during training
muon_ns_coefficients: Newton-Schulz polynomial coefficient scheme used by Muon (fixed quintic vs per-iteration Polar-Express style)
lookahead_peak_decay_base: Base b of the peak Lookahead slow-weight decay b**k (k = cadence)
ema_tail_averaging: EMA of trainable params and BN buffers applied only during the final part of the schedule, copied into the eval model at the end
ema_update_every_steps: Number of train steps between EMA updates
ema_decay: Decay coefficient of the EMA update (lerp weight on old value)
